_comment: MCP servers Forge connects to at startup. ${VAR} placeholders come from the environment (.env) plus WORKSPACE (the project Forge works on), PROJECT_ROOT and PYTHON (this interpreter). "read_only": true marks every tool of a server as safe to run without confirmation. Set "enabled": false to skip a server.

filesystem.description: Official MCP filesystem server: read, write, edit and search files inside the workspace
